quests.title: Versus Ookubo Sanzaemon

dialogue.t: Very good. Allow me to test my skills against you.
I shall take this as a rehearsal for my duel against the "mightiest warrior."
You need not know who that is, for you shall be defeated here by my hand. Come, let us begin!

dialogue.sit: Give me a second to prepare.

dialogue.t: Excellent! My sword shall show no mercy.

quests.description: Ookubo Sanzaemon, a former main clan estate guard who was fired for failing to prevent thieves from jumping over the wall, wishes to battle!
